accepted.development: Solo side project in small chunks, with long pauses; programming and configuration are comfortable; avoid art/model/map creation.
accepted.audience: Java vanilla client with required resource pack; aim to stay on latest versions; about 15 concurrent players at release.
accepted.core: Factions, blasters, KOTH and Jabba dungeon were successful previously. Lightsabers and armor are core. Force powers are deferred.
accepted.worldRules: Only main survival world is buildable. Other planets can be dungeon destinations. Resource planets are deferred. Remove selected vanilla features including villages, potions and elytra; exact disable list pending.
accepted.pvp: Enabled broadly outside safe areas such as spawnpoints. Death drops all carried items including armor and weapons.
accepted.raids: Offline bases may be vulnerable if warpoints are depleted. No TNT cannons. Grenade/explosive breach rules and warpoint mechanics undecided.
accepted.maps: Original Jabba/KOTH maps and mob/plugin configurations remain on a server the user can pull up.
accepted.assets: User has models, sounds, menus, armor, mobs and item assets; repository archive inspected.
accepted.developmentApproach: Clean laptop-hosted development server, selective recovery from older attempts, feature branches integrated into main after satisfaction. Gameplay plugin boundaries first; voting and chat presentation deferred.
accepted.pluginOwnership: Accepted the proposed public/custom division; plugins may be replaced later when beneficial.
accepted.groupIdentity: Player-facing naming must replace Factions and the /f command root across commands, help, menus, messages and tutorial text. Final name and command are undecided. FactionsUUID remains the selected underlying integration.
accepted.designMethod: Player experience first, feature ordering second, then parameterized Java systems and configured content.
accepted.firstSession: New players arrive in the existing SpawnWorld map, receive a short tutorial (format undecided), then enter survival at a fixed protected landing zone to establish a base.
accepted.starterFaction: Solo players can create a faction and claim a starter base on eligible land outside the spawn safe zone without a credit requirement. A possible three-hour faction creation cooldown is tentative, not accepted.
accepted.deathRecovery: Death loses carried equipment. Respawn priority is group home, then a valid bed, then SpawnWorld. Players can re-equip from stored supplies; otherwise they repeat the original acquisition route for the gear. No separate replacement mechanic. Voluntary travel remains undecided.
accepted.creditIncome: A mixture of selling resources and activity rewards.
accepted.equipmentAcquisition: Sell ordinary survival resources to buy basic blasters and ammo; craft basic armor from survival materials; earn credits and rare components from KOTH/Jabba to craft lightsabers and advanced equipment.
accepted.resourcePlanets: Deferred for now; the initial loop uses ordinary survival resources and in-scope activities.
accepted.combatEscape: Combat blocks voluntary teleporting. Logging out in combat causes death and normal carried-item loss. Tag duration, triggers and server-initiated disconnect handling remain undecided.
accepted.starterEquipment: A basic blaster, vanilla tools and food are granted only on first join. Exact items, quantities and ammo are undecided. Starting credits and their amount remain tentative.
accepted.firstFriendsPlaytest: The in-scope gameplay systems should work together in a rough integrated version. Small development slices lead toward this target; content depth remains undecided. Force powers and resource planets are deferred.

acquisition.loop: Sell ordinary survival resources to buy basic blasters and ammo; craft basic armor from survival materials; earn credits and rare components from KOTH/Jabba to craft lightsabers and advanced equipment.
acquisition.unresolved: Specific equipment variants, recipes, prices, tiers, drop rates and grind duration.

groupNamingProposal.implementationStatus: Not implemented; verify command ownership and language customization during integration.

travelProposal.recommendation: Free spawn and faction-home commands plus a public-destination travel menu, also accessible through optional themed terminals. Survival uses the fixed protected landing zone.
travelProposal.warmupCancellation: Movement or damage; all entry points enforce combat restrictions.
travelProposal.limits: No death-return back command or arbitrary personal-home network initially; other-player teleports undecided. Vehicles serve exploration and routes beyond fixed destinations.
travelProposal.evidenceLimit: Published server guides show comparable designs, not measured player preference or verified live settings. Minecadia's page was last edited in 2023; PirateCraft's guide includes older version references.

nextAction: Define lightsaber defenses against blasters and the intended power gap between basic and advanced equipment.
